name: Yagiura Azusa
source:
Main heroine of the game. Protagonist's daughter-in law. One year older than her husband.

Bright, social and friendly personality, that can get along with anyone quickly.

However, does not try to curry favours by flattery. Has the strength to express own's opinion clearly.

If anything, a strong-minded person but a type to completely devote to her beloved.

Likes to move her body. During school days, a sports girl, who was part of track and field club which participated in National Athletic meet.

However, started getting bullied by other girls who were jealous of her. By chance, got caught up in compensated dating.

Started having casual flings with many men and reached the conclusion: sexual compatibility with older men was the best.

Had many lover like relationships with older men.

The protagonist was one of them and the favourite.

After saving money earned from compensated dating, went to join an university. Simultaneously, stopped engaging in compensated dating.

Met with Protagonist's son, Naotaka in the university's tennis club, started getting along and developed into a relationship.

Furthermore, since sexual compatibility was good, also married at the same time as university graduation.

Ran with Naotaka because her mother-in law started pressuring them to have children soon.

Ended up living in the protagonist's house.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=913722&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
